Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Meenakshi - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Nikhil, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil peeks out from behind the door.]

Nikhil: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil slips and falls.]

Nikhil (happily): "Careful!"

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Nikhil: "What happened?"

[Snow begins to fall.]

Nikhil (excited): "Hmm, I see."

[The sun rises over the village.]

Meenakshi: "Hmm, I see."

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Nikhil: "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look over here."

[Nikhil sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Meenakshi: "That's great!"

[Nikhil mops the floor.]

Nikhil: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil irons his school shirt.]

Nikhil (excited): "What a day to remember!"
